bag.help:
Usage: bag [options] [command]

Scaffold, run, deploy, and monetize a single seller agent on BNB Chain.

Options:
  --version              output the version number
  -h, --help             display help for command

Commands:
  init [options] <name>  Create a new bnbagent-studio seller agent project.
  dev [options]          Run the Agent locally.
  deploy [options]       Deploy the agent after explicitly selecting a provider
                         (bnb|aws|azure); lifecycle subcommands inspect recorded
                         deployments.
  scan [options]         Detect project framework + manifest (read-only).
  skills                 Install Claude Code skills into the host IDE.
  recipe                 Print recipe code/files (agent / wallet / 8004).
  agents                 Local agent project registry
                         (~/.bnbagent-studio/projects.toml).
  config                 Read / write studio.toml.
  env                    Edit project .env.local idempotently.
  budget                 Opt-in auto-topup policy for Pieverse LLM.
  audit                  View on-chain action audit log.
  wallet                 Wallet keystore helpers (create / list / inspect).
  erc8004                ERC-8004 identity (register / show / resolve /
                         update-endpoint / update-metadata / get-metadata /
                         clear-pending).
  erc8183                ERC-8183 commerce (list / buy / status / submit / fetch
                         / settle).
  x402                   x402 payment client helpers.
  mpp                    Native MPP+B402 payment client helpers.
  llm                    LLM provider helpers (test / inspect).
  doctor [options]       Diagnose project + environment.
  platform               Managed-platform account ops (login / logout / whoami /
                         agents / credit / token), delegated to the pinned
                         bnbagent deploy CLI.
  bundle [options]       Bundle a seller workspace + pinned SDK/runtime tarballs
                         for handoff.
  help [command]         display help for command

bag deploy.help:
Usage: bag deploy [options] [command]

Deploy the agent after explicitly selecting a provider (bnb|aws|azure);
lifecycle subcommands inspect recorded deployments.

Options:
  --provider <provider>               Provider: bnb|aws|azure. Required for
                                      non-interactive deploy; lifecycle commands
                                      need it only when multiple records exist.
  --backend <backend>                 Managed backend confirmation for
                                      --provider bnb (aws or azure). It must
                                      match [stack].runtime. (choices: "aws",
                                      "azure")
  --project-root <path>               Override project root.
  --skip-prepare                      Skip non-storage local readiness checks.
  --force-deploy-broken-storage       DANGEROUS: bypass fatal
                                      deliverable-storage checks.
  --force                             Bypass explicitly forceable readiness
                                      checks.
  --secrets-mode <mode>               Runtime secret delivery mode. (choices:
                                      "secretsmanager", "envvars", default:
                                      "secretsmanager")
  --accept-risk                       Accept provider risk/terms disclosures.
  --yes                               Confirm the selected deployment plan
                                      non-interactively.
  --allow-multiple                    Allow creating a deployment while another
                                      provider remains active.
  --skip-smoke                        Skip the delegated post-deploy smoke
                                      check.
  -h, --help                          display help for command

Commands:
  prepare [options]                   Run the deploy-readiness sweep on this
                                      project.
  agent [options] [agentcoreArgs...]  Deprecated compatibility alias for `bag
                                      deploy`. Thin wrapper: gates on prepare,
                                      syncs runtime secrets, builds the agent
                                      (`pnpm build`), delegates to the platform
                                      CLI.
  verify [options]                    Probe a deployed endpoint + reconcile
                                      ERC-8004 identity.
  status [options]                    Report recorded deploy state + best-effort
                                      liveness (read-only).
  info [options]                      Show the buyer-access surface for a
                                      platform or Azure self-deploy.
  destroy [options]                   Print a teardown plan (default dry-run);
                                      --execute tears down the agent (AgentCore
                                      runtime + runtime secret + recorded
                                      state).
  logs [options]                      Show the selected deployment's logs via
                                      bnbagent-deploy.
  fix-gitignore [options]             Ensure the workspace .gitignore excludes
                                      .studio/ (the agent's .env.local +
                                      keystore).

bag doctor.help:
Usage: bag doctor [options]

Diagnose project + environment.

Options:
  --project-root <path>  Override project root.
  --network <name>       Override studio.toml [network].default for RPC
                         reachability check.
  --check-env            Safely report presence/length/sha256-prefix of known
                         secret keys in .studio/.env.local (never prints any
                         secret value).
  -h, --help             display help for command

bag erc8004.help:
Usage: bag erc8004 [options] [command]

ERC-8004 identity (register / show / resolve / update-endpoint / update-metadata
/ get-metadata / clear-pending).

Options:
  -h, --help                    display help for command

Commands:
  register [options]            Register this wallet as an ERC-8004 agent.
  show [options]                Show this wallet's on-chain agent record.
  resolve [options] <agent_id>  Resolve an agent_id to its agentURI.
  update-endpoint [options]     Update this wallet's registered service endpoint
                                on ERC-8004.
  update-metadata [options]     Set an arbitrary metadata key/value on this
                                wallet's ERC-8004 agent.
  get-metadata [options]        Read a metadata value by key from this wallet's
                                ERC-8004 agent.
  clear-pending [options]       Clear stale [identity] pending_* state from
                                studio.toml (e.g. an unverified relay tx that
                                never reached the chain). Refuses when the
                                pending tx is still known to the chain RPC
                                unless --force.

bag erc8183.help:
Usage: bag erc8183 [options] [command]

ERC-8183 commerce (list / buy / status / submit / fetch / settle).

Options:
  -h, --help                                 display help for command

Commands:
  list [options]                             List recent on-chain jobs.
  buy [options] [task]                       Buy a job: create / register / set_budget / fund.
  status [options] <job_id>                  Show on-chain summary for a job.
  submit [options] <job_id> <response_text>  Seller: submit a deliverable for a job.
  fetch [options] <job_id>                   Buyer: fetch the deliverable URL for a submitted job.
  settle [options] <job_id>                  Buyer: settle a submitted job.

bag recipe.help:
Usage: bag recipe [options] [command]

Print recipe code/files (agent / wallet / 8004).

Options:
  -h, --help             display help for command

Commands:
  list                   List bundled recipes.
  show <name>            Print recipe metadata only.
  code [options] <name>  Render recipe (metadata + template files) to stdout.

bag wallet.help:
Usage: bag wallet [options] [command]

Wallet keystore helpers (create / list / inspect).

Options:
  -h, --help           display help for command

Commands:
  new [options]        Create or import a local EVM keystore.
  twak-init [options]  Create the project's twak wallet without YOU typing the
                       password on a command line (wallet.kind=twak): wraps
                       `twak wallet create --no-keychain` reading the password
                       from stdin / a 0600 file / a hidden prompt, seeds the
                       NaaS credentials, then adopts the address like `bag
                       wallet new`. twak requires --password on its own argv, so
                       the value does reach that short-lived child process.
  show [options]       Show the wallet configured in studio.toml.
  list [options]       List keystore addresses under [wallet] keystore_dir.
  sign [options]       Sign an arbitrary message with the loaded wallet.
  balance [options]    Show native (BNB/tBNB) + U balances for the configured
                       network(s).
  policy [options]     Inspect the wallet's SigningPolicy (read-only).
  session              Manage the bounded Altana session used by the Agent.
  help [command]       display help for command

bag x402.help:
Usage: bag x402 [options] [command]

x402 payment client helpers.

Options:
  -h, --help                  display help for command

Commands:
  quote [options] <url>       Probe an x402-protected URL without paying
                              (returns 402 challenge).
  buy [options] <url>         Pay an x402-protected URL with $U via EIP-3009.
  trust [options] <merchant>  Trust an x402 merchant: probe its live 402,
                              confirm payTo + price, write
                              [payments.x402.merchants.<name>] to studio.toml.
  sell                        Configure and inspect the B402-backed x402 seller
                              rail.
